text.shot1: Scattered dots converge into one on a paper-white field.
text.shot2: The dot splits into a grid and every third dot greys out as the counter rolls.
text.shot3: Hit: the grid collapses into bars of lost hours, with anticipation and overshoot.
text.shot4: Hit: the bars fold back into one dot, which becomes a toggle and switches on.
text.shot5: Hit: a halftone field opens a window for the hero number in a fluid teal fill.
text.shot6: Hit: the dot becomes a tile and steps through the week, a day per beat.
text.shot7: Hit: the tile stretches into a pill around the offer.
text.shot8: Hit: the last morph slams the logo together on the loudest hit, then silence.
